scope: Offline real page with synthetic identity, API and payment. No cloud writes or visual acceptance.

results.name: failed initialization does not create and keeps requirement
successful initialization ends loading and enables submission
missing service never loads or submits
pending load rejects submit and duplicate read
retry preserves requirement and selected address by ID after reorder
empty addresses retains current binding fallback after successful load
late load after onHide does not update page
late load after onUnload does not update page
reentry accepts fresh read and rejects older response
busy submit blocks read, editing and repeated submit
late create after onHide does not pay, navigate or toast
late create after onUnload does not pay, navigate or toast
hide and return before create resolves does not auto pay or navigate
late payment result after leave does not navigate or toast
same unknown create result retries original request ID
different user cannot resume previous user order
